title: WildTrace: the open atlas of illegal wildlife trade
description: An open-source map of the global illegal wildlife trade in fauna and flora: seizures, arrests and convictions from public reports, each case graded by the strength of its evidence (validated, official, corroborated, single report), with an in-browser link-analysis workbench. The archived release includes the pipeline code (MIT) and the published case data in web/data/ (CC BY 4.0). No person accused is named.
notes: Data files under web/data/ are licensed CC BY 4.0; code is MIT.
